name: freerdc
description: Local FreeRDC MCP bundle for guarded workspace automation.

directory.title: Workspace directories
directory.description: One or more local workspace directories to expose. Use absolute paths; access stays within these roots.

local_power_tools.title: Enable local-power tools
local_power_tools.description: WARNING: Enable only when you explicitly want commands, GUI actions, browser actions, system inspection, and document tools. This grants access beyond workspace-only file operations.

tools.name: fs_stat
tools.description: Inspect a file or directory inside an allowed workspace. Use it before edits to obtain its type, size, and modification time; paths must be absolute and contained by a configured root.

tools.name: fs_list
tools.description: List entries in an allowed workspace directory. Use it to discover files before choosing an absolute path; an empty directory is a valid workspace state.

tools.name: fs_read
tools.description: Read a file from an allowed workspace as UTF-8 or Base64. Use Base64 for binary data; absolute paths outside configured roots are rejected.

tools.name: fs_info
tools.description: Get detailed metadata for a file or directory in an allowed workspace. Use it to inspect permissions and text line information before a guarded write, move, or deletion.

tools.name: fs_read_batch
tools.description: Read up to 20 allowed workspace files in one request. Use it when comparing known files; each path remains independently subject to containment checks.

tools.name: fs_read_lines
tools.description: Read a bounded line range from an allowed workspace text file. Use it to inspect a large file incrementally without reading all of it.

tools.name: fs_tree
tools.description: Return a bounded recursive directory tree below an allowed workspace path. Use it to understand project layout; depth and entry limits can truncate results.

tools.name: fs_search
tools.description: Search file contents below an allowed workspace path. Use it to locate text before reading or editing; result and byte limits may truncate the search.

tools.name: fs_mkdir_p
tools.description: Create an allowed workspace directory and any missing parents. Use it before creating a new nested file; dryRun=plan reports the action without changing files.

tools.name: fs_mkdir
tools.description: Create one new directory inside an allowed workspace. Use it when the parent already exists; it does not replace an existing directory and supports dry-run planning.

tools.name: fs_write
tools.description: Create or replace a workspace file with text or Base64 data. Use an expected SHA-256 when replacing existing content and dryRun=plan to preview; writes are confined to allowed roots.

tools.name: fs_patch
tools.description: Replace verified literal text in an allowed workspace file. Use it for precise edits after reading the file; it requires the current SHA-256 and supports dry-run planning.

tools.name: fs_append
tools.description: Append text or Base64 data to an allowed workspace file. Use it only after checking the required current SHA-256; this changes file contents and supports dry-run planning.

tools.name: fs_delete
tools.description: Delete a file inside an allowed workspace. Use only when removal is intended; provide the current SHA-256 and use dryRun=plan to preview without deletion.

tools.name: fs_move
tools.description: Move or rename a file between allowed workspace paths. Use an expected SHA-256 to prevent stale changes and dryRun=plan before changing the file location.

tools.name: device_list
tools.description: List registered FreeRDC devices and their capabilities. Use it before a device tool call; it exposes only safe device identity and availability data.

tools.name: system_health
tools.description: Report FreeRDC service health, enabled capabilities, and kill-switch state. Use it to diagnose whether a capability is available before invoking it.

tools.name: policy_describe
tools.description: Report enforced operation limits, enabled capabilities, and verified workspace roots when available. Use it to choose an absolute workspace path; credentials and unrelated machine paths are not disclosed.

tools.name: audit_tail
tools.description: Read a bounded tail of FreeRDC audit records. Use it to review recent tool outcomes; records are limited and do not grant access to the underlying resources.

tools.name: usage_stats
tools.description: Summarize recent audited actions and outcomes. Use it for operational diagnostics; the result is derived from a bounded audit history.

tools.name: recent_calls
tools.description: List a bounded, sanitized history of completed tool calls. Use it to understand recent activity without reading full audit payloads.

tools.name: who_am_i
tools.description: Identify the FreeRDC server or local runtime context. Use it to confirm which runtime is connected; it does not return account credentials.

tools.name: get_prompts
tools.description: Retrieve a curated FreeRDC onboarding prompt by ID. Use it to start a common safe workflow; only the documented prompt IDs are accepted.

tools.name: device_ping
tools.description: Check whether a registered remote FreeRDC device is reachable. Use it before a remote operation; the device must already be registered and online.

tools.name: device_disconnect
tools.description: Disconnect a registered remote FreeRDC device. Use it only to end that device session; subsequent remote operations require reconnection.

tools.name: device_shutdown
tools.description: Request shutdown of a registered remote device. Use only with explicit intent because it interrupts that device; the device must acknowledge the request.

tools.name: device_fs_stat
tools.description: Inspect a file or directory on a registered remote device. Use it before remote edits; the device must be online and enforces its own allowed roots.

tools.name: device_fs_list
tools.description: List an allowed directory on a registered remote device. Use it to discover remote files; the device must be online and enforces its own containment policy.

tools.name: device_fs_read
tools.description: Read an allowed file from a registered remote device. Use UTF-8 or Base64 as appropriate; the remote device must be online and authorizes its own paths.

tools.name: device_fs_search
tools.description: Search allowed files on a registered remote device. Use it to locate remote content before reading or editing; remote search limits may truncate results.

tools.name: device_fs_mkdir
tools.description: Create an allowed directory on a registered remote device. Use dryRun=plan before changing the device; the remote device must be online.

tools.name: device_fs_write
tools.description: Create or replace an allowed remote file. Use a current hash when available and dryRun=plan to preview; the remote device applies its own authorization.

tools.name: device_fs_delete
tools.description: Delete an allowed remote file after verifying its current SHA-256. Use dryRun=plan first when possible; the remote device must be online.

tools.name: device_fs_move
tools.description: Move or rename an allowed remote file. Use a current SHA-256 and dryRun=plan to avoid stale or unintended changes; the remote device enforces containment.

tools.name: device_process_start
tools.description: Start an approved process on a registered remote device. Use only when execution is intended; the remote device must be online and applies its command policy.

tools.name: device_process_read
tools.description: Read and consume buffered output for a remote process. Use it after starting a process; repeated reads can differ because returned output is consumed.

tools.name: device_process_input
tools.description: Send text or Base64 input to a running remote process. Use only for the intended process because input can change its behavior.

tools.name: device_process_kill
tools.description: Stop a process on a registered remote device. Use only when termination is intended; the remote device must be online and the process ID must be valid.

tools.name: device_process_list
tools.description: List processes managed by a registered remote device. Use it to find a process ID before reading, sending input, or stopping a process.

tools.name: terminal_start
tools.description: Start an approved local process without waiting for completion. Use terminal_read or process_wait afterwards; command policy, working-directory limits, and dry-run checks apply.

tools.name: terminal_exec
tools.description: Run an approved local command and return its bounded output. Use it for a command expected to finish; command policy and output limits apply, and dryRun=plan makes no change.

tools.name: terminal_exec_batch
tools.description: Run up to eight approved local commands and return bounded per-command results. Use it for independent commands; each command remains subject to command policy and output limits.

tools.name: process_wait
tools.description: Wait up to the requested timeout for a managed process to exit. Use it after terminal_start; it reads status and does not send process input.

tools.name: terminal_read
tools.description: Read and consume buffered output and status of a managed local process. Use it after starting a process; repeated reads can differ and output may be truncated by configured limits.

tools.name: terminal_input
tools.description: Send text or Base64 input to a managed local process. Use only for the intended process because input can change command behavior.

tools.name: terminal_kill
tools.description: Stop a managed local process by ID. Use only when termination is intended; force changes how termination is requested.

tools.name: process_kill
tools.description: Stop a managed local process by ID. Use only when termination is intended; force changes how termination is requested.

tools.name: terminal_list
tools.description: List local processes currently managed by FreeRDC. Use it to find a process ID before reading output, sending input, waiting, or stopping it.

tools.name: process_list
tools.description: List local processes currently managed by FreeRDC. Use it to find a process ID before reading output, sending input, waiting, or stopping it.

tools.name: system_snapshot
tools.description: Report a sanitized local system snapshot. Use it for diagnostics before local-power actions; it does not expose credentials.

tools.name: system_ping
tools.description: Check that the local-power runtime is responsive. Use it before local-power operations when availability is uncertain.

tools.name: system_identity
tools.description: Report a sanitized identity for the local runtime. Use it to confirm the connected machine; it does not return credentials.

tools.name: service_restart
tools.description: Restart the local FreeRDC service after an explicit confirmation token. Use only to recover or apply local service changes; dryRun=plan does not restart it.

tools.name: system_processes
tools.description: List a bounded set of local system processes sorted by CPU or memory. Use it for diagnostics before requesting a targeted process stop.

tools.name: network_listeners
tools.description: List a bounded set of local listening network endpoints. Use it for diagnostics; the result is observational and may be limited.

tools.name: system_process_kill
tools.description: Stop a local system process after matching its expected command. Use only with explicit intent; PID and command matching reduce accidental termination.

tools.name: search_start
tools.description: Start a bounded local search and return a search ID. Use search_results to page through it and search_stop to release it; search state can expire.

tools.name: search_results
tools.description: Read a page of results from a previously started local search. Use the search ID from search_start; result availability depends on retained search state.

tools.name: search_stop
tools.description: Stop a retained local search and release its state. Use it when results are no longer needed; stopping an already absent search is safe.

tools.name: search_list
tools.description: List retained local searches. Use it to find an active search ID before reading results or stopping a search.

tools.name: config_get
tools.description: Read the small set of safe local FreeRDC configuration values. Use it before changing a supported setting; secrets are not included.

tools.name: config_set
tools.description: Set a supported local FreeRDC configuration value. Use only for the named setting accepted by the schema; writing the same value is idempotent.

tools.name: project_search
tools.description: Search a local project path for text. Use it to locate source before reading or editing; the local-power runtime applies its project safeguards.

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Read Git working-tree status for a local project path. Use it before edits or commits; it does not modify the repository.

tools.name: git_diff
tools.description: Read a bounded Git diff for a local project path. Use it to review unstaged or staged changes; it does not modify the repository.

tools.name: headless_browser_get
tools.description: Fetch and extract bounded text from a URL with the headless browser. Use it to inspect a web page; it makes an external network request.

tools.name: headless_browser_screenshot
tools.description: Load a URL and save a screenshot to an authorized path. Use dryRun=plan before writing; it makes an external network request and changes the local filesystem.

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.description: List tabs in the selected local browser. Use it to choose a tab before activation; it only observes the local browser.

tools.name: browser_open
tools.description: Open a URL in the selected local browser. Use it only when navigation is intended; the browser may make external network requests.

tools.name: give_feedback_to_desktop_commander
tools.description: Open the Desktop Commander feedback page in Chrome. Use it only when the user intends to provide feedback; it opens an external website.

tools.name: browser_activate_tab
tools.description: Bring a specified tab in the selected local browser to the foreground. Use it to focus an existing tab; indices must come from browser_tabs.

tools.name: gui_apps
tools.description: List eligible local GUI applications. Use it to select an application before an explicit GUI action.

tools.name: gui_activate_app
tools.description: Bring an eligible local GUI application to the foreground. Use it before an intended GUI interaction; it changes local window focus.

tools.name: gui_keystroke
tools.description: Send text keystrokes to an eligible local GUI application. Use only with explicit intent because it can modify application data or trigger actions.

tools.name: gui_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a local GUI screenshot to an authorized path. Use dryRun=plan before writing; screenshots can contain sensitive on-screen information.

tools.name: gui_click
tools.description: Click a coordinate in an eligible local GUI application. Use only with explicit intent because a click can trigger application actions.

tools.name: document_read
tools.description: Extract bounded content from an allowed text, PDF, DOCX, or XLSX document. Use it to inspect a document before editing; page, sheet, range, and character limits apply.

tools.name: pdf_create
tools.description: Create a PDF from Markdown at an allowed path. Use dryRun=plan before writing and provide a current hash when replacing an existing file.

tools.name: pdf_edit
tools.description: Create an edited PDF by deleting or inserting pages into a destination file. Use dryRun=plan before writing; source and insertion files must be authorized.

tools.name: pdf_render
tools.description: Render selected PDF pages into image files in an allowed output directory. Use dryRun=plan before creating files; page and dimension limits apply.

tools.name: docx_create
tools.description: Create a DOCX document from Markdown at an allowed path. Use dryRun=plan before writing and provide a current hash when replacing an existing file.

tools.name: docx_patch
tools.description: Apply a verified XML replacement inside an allowed DOCX document. Use only after reading and hashing the current file; dryRun=plan previews the change.

tools.name: xlsx_write
tools.description: Create or replace an XLSX worksheet from bounded rows. Use dryRun=plan before writing and provide a current hash when replacing a file.

tools.name: xlsx_patch
tools.description: Replace a bounded XLSX cell range in an allowed workbook. Use a current SHA-256 and dryRun=plan to prevent stale or unintended changes.
